title: Missing moeb tool: Read (large tool output)
description: The start_spec tool consistently returns results exceeding the inline response limit (~140K characters), saved to disk. An external Read tool is required to access this content in chunks on every spec run. No moeb tool exists for reading harness-saved large tool result files.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a moeb tool (e.g. read_tool_result) that accepts a saved tool result path and returns it in paginated chunks, eliminating the need for external Read calls on oversized tool outputs.
